title: The derived tensor product of sheaves is a two-variable left derived functor
statement:
The derived tensor product $-\otimes^{\mathrm L}-$ of [def-sfb-derived-tensor-sheaves],
together with the lax monoidal structure map of the localization functor, is the left
derived functor in two variables of the tensor product of complexes of pro-étale sheaves,
with respect to the quasi-isomorphisms in each variable.

proof.text: This is part of [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal], applied to $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$.

      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
